goals.title: Build factory core
goals.description: Build the neutral SVFactory core that can load, validate, compile, and materialize KBX agents from DNA.
goals.success_criteria: SVFactory can generate a KBX agent package skeleton from a valid DNA spec.

sub_goals.title: Ship the DNA loader, validator, and compiler path
sub_goals.description: Make DNA ingestion deterministic from contract loading through compiled manifest generation.
sub_goals.success_criteria: A valid DNA package can be loaded, validated, and compiled without manual intervention.

key_results.title: Load all four DNA contracts
key_results.description: Support dna.json, ontology.json, governance.json, and release.json loading from one spec root.
key_results.success_criteria: One command resolves all four contract files from a spec root with zero missing references.

key_results.title: Compile a deterministic DNA manifest
key_results.description: Produce a compiled manifest that downstream materialization can consume.
key_results.success_criteria: The compiler emits one deterministic manifest per valid DNA spec.

sub_goals.title: Materialize a KBX package skeleton
sub_goals.description: Turn the compiled manifest into a KBX-shaped output plan and package skeleton.
sub_goals.success_criteria: SVFactory produces a valid KBX package skeleton from the compiled manifest.

key_results.title: Generate a KBX output plan
key_results.description: Map compiled DNA into package directories, assets, bindings, and templates.
key_results.success_criteria: The materializer outputs one complete filesystem plan for a KBX package.

key_results.title: Bootstrap a runnable KBX package shell
key_results.description: Emit the first runnable package scaffold from SVFactory.
key_results.success_criteria: The generated package installs and exposes its initial CLI/UI shell.

goals.title: Define KBX DNA schema v0.1
goals.description: Standardize how domain DNA is described so KBX agents can be generated repeatably.
goals.success_criteria: A domain DNA can be authored and validated using a stable v0.1 schema contract.

key_results.title: Lock the four contract files
key_results.description: Use dna.json, ontology.json, governance.json, and release.json as the canonical v0.1 contract set.
key_results.success_criteria: Every KBX DNA package declares the same four canonical files.

key_results.title: Roundtrip one reference DNA through validation
key_results.description: Use dna/kbx as the first reference DNA package for schema proof.
key_results.success_criteria: The reference DNA validates with zero contract errors.

goals.title: Publish first KBX agent npm package
goals.description: Ship the first user-installable KBX agent package generated by SVFactory.
goals.success_criteria: An end user can install and run the first generated KBX agent package.

key_results.title: Make the generated package installable
key_results.description: Ensure the generated KBX package can be installed from an npm tarball.
key_results.success_criteria: npm install succeeds for the generated agent package.

key_results.title: Complete the first publish path
key_results.description: Prove the package can move from generated artifact to published package.
key_results.success_criteria: One generated agent package reaches a publish-ready release candidate state.

goals.title: Build quality gate
goals.description: Make sure a KBX package does not only build, but also validates and tests successfully.
goals.success_criteria: Every generated package passes a deterministic quality gate before release.

key_results.title: Enforce schema and compile gates
key_results.description: Stop invalid DNA packages before materialization or release.
key_results.success_criteria: Invalid DNA cannot pass contract validation or compile gates.

key_results.title: Run generated package smoke tests
key_results.description: Add smoke tests proving the generated package can start and expose its expected shell.
key_results.success_criteria: Every release candidate package passes smoke tests before publish.

goals.title: Build maintainability flow
goals.description: Design the generated package and the factory itself so they can be fixed, upgraded, versioned, and released sustainably.
goals.success_criteria: SVFactory and generated KBX packages have deterministic upgrade and maintenance paths.

key_results.title: Define versioning and upgrade contracts
key_results.description: Version both DNA and generated package outputs with clear compatibility rules.
key_results.success_criteria: A maintainer can tell what version changed and how to upgrade it.

key_results.title: Define bugfix and release maintenance flow
key_results.description: Make bugfix, patch, and release work part of the canonical factory process.
key_results.success_criteria: Generated KBX packages can be patched and released without manual ad hoc steps.
